title: sam_fast failure with triton 3.5
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

sam_fast `failure to run` https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/16972332237/job/48126785722 - bisects to https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/pull/7857.

bisect script: https://gist.github.com/davidberard98/0304f27ecb8559b44402a0b9255be055 (important because the repro relies on some caches being cleared)

The issue appears to be a bad interaction between cudagraphs and the changes in https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/pull/7857 (@aakhundov is investigating).

We're disabling sam_fast in CI until we resolve this issue (and will probably cut 2.9 RC1 with this regression, as we'd like to get Triton 3.5 signal from the RC1 and don't expect this regression will affect too many things, considering that only one benchmark is failing due to the issue)

### Versions

H100
nightly pytorch, Triton release 3.5.x branch
